description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenCdmExt API, which interacts with the OpenCdmSystem and OpenCdmSession components. It uses Google Test framework to verify behaviors such as session limit retrieval, secure stop management, key store operations, challenge data handling, license storage, key ID selection, and cleanup procedures.
